# logcut v0.1.2

This release strengthens failure and process handling while keeping `logcut` small, direct, and dependency-free.

## Changes

* Limited failure-summary log reads to a fixed-size tail to keep memory usage bounded.
* Escalated ignored `HUP`, `INT`, and `TERM` signals to `SIGKILL` after a short grace period.
* Ensured remaining child processes are cleaned up even when the direct child exits first.
* Applied `LOGCUT_SUMMARY_LINES` as the final line limit for every summary profile.
* Preserved the original child command exit code when the retained log cannot be read.
* Added focused integration tests for large logs, signal escalation, summary limits, and log-read failures.
* Added a manually triggered pull-request validation workflow.

## Compatibility

The existing command-line interface, profiles, environment variables, output format, and documented exit-code behavior remain unchanged.
